entities.name: west sedan chair

entities.vis: full
entities.src: sections.md: two tall dark boxes on the far side (the lead's first look)
entities.note: Body u 10613-10700 (west end strip u 10613-10633), dome top v 617, bottom v 803-810, i.e. ~25 px above the bearers' foot line (v ~830): carried, not set down. entities.name: big gnarled old tree behind the east sedan

entities.vis: part: foot hidden behind the sedan poles
entities.note: West stem: trunk u 10895-11002 between v 420 and ~680; a pale gap at u ~10995-11013 (v 540-600) separates it from a second mottled mass at u 11013-11080, which t3 records as S4.tree.willow_stem_11020. Merge (lead): one tree with twin stems from one foot, u 10895-11080; the east stem (t3's S4.tree.willow_stem_11020, dropped) is part of it. Base moved from the west stem's foot (10950, 685, est) to the shared foot (10990, 690, est) between the stems; the restyle paints the east stem as a man in a red robe, which the strokes do not show (bark texture, closed trunk outline at u ~11075).
